mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk tied the systems together: the result explained that muscles need both nerve signals and materials carried by blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the digestive and urinary organs into their named slots was clear, but felt more like following placement instructions than making a meaningful choice.

surprise.text: Joining the chest and lower body made it clearer that the diaphragm separates them while nerves, blood vessels and the food pipe pass between regions by their own routes.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though several fittings followed named slots rather than requiring much reasoning.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored a new connection between body systems. This finale was satisfying, though the repeated fitting steps were fairly predictable.
